name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - § 36 - Am 96
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 36. Emphasizes that payment appropriations must reflect actual and duly justified needs in terms of implementation; calls for rigorous expenditure control, sound financial management, and the identification of savings before any additional resources are mobilized;
